concept_name: Bluewater Sailcat 15 — low-workload offshore cruising catamaran

mission.mission_statement: A robust bluewater cruising catamaran optimised for long-range sailing, predictable offshore motion, safe reefed and degraded modes, low crew workload, maintainability, usable payload and good anchor comfort.
mission.operating_region: Open-water and coastal cruising with route-specific storm avoidance; polar, ice and extreme-weather claims excluded until separately assessed.
mission.route_profile: Concept study across upwind, reaching, downwind, light-air and reefed/heavy-weather operation with auxiliary-motor harbour and calms modes.

target_cruise_speed_kn.rationale: Sustainable passage-speed target for mission trade studies; not an achieved speed prediction.

target_range_nmi.rationale: Provisional range between resupply/refit opportunities; sailing range depends on weather, route and onboard reserves.

voyage_duration_days.rationale: Initial stores, freshwater and endurance stress window.

crew_capacity.rationale: Working crew assumption; sail-handling workload and watchkeeping require human-factors review.

payload_capacity.rationale: Payload allowance must come from displacement, stability, rig, tankage and stores budget.

length_overall_m.rationale: Selected scale for the first bluewater catamaran design study.

length_waterline_m.rationale: Set from hull-form and trim optimisation; do not infer solely from LOA.

overall_beam_m.rationale: Choose with righting/roll behaviour, port/berth limits, structural load, sailing rig and storm recovery trade-offs.

demihull_beam_m.rationale: Set against displacement, slenderness and buildable internal volume.

hull_centerline_spacing_m.rationale: Design-space variable; balance wave interference, stability, bridge-deck loads, beam and berthing limits.

hull_spacing_over_lwl.rationale: Optimise against validated hydrodynamic/seakeeping evidence, not a universal rule.

design_draft_m.rationale: Depends on keels/daggerboards, rudders, appendages and intended shallow-water access.

wet_deck_clearance_m.rationale: Must be selected with wave encounter, slamming, cross-deck structure and vertical CG.

wet_deck_clearance_over_draft.rationale: Dimensionless clearance design variable to compare across loading states and waves.

displacement_tonnes.rationale: Require weight estimate, systems, rig and margin budget.

demihull_slenderness_lwl_over_beam.rationale: Trade reduced wave-making against usable volume, wetted area, structural and loading effects.

geometry.hull_form_hypothesis: Slender displacement demihulls with multiple bow-volume and rocker variants; no chosen hull geometry yet.
geometry.volume_distribution_hypothesis: Compare forward reserve buoyancy, central volume and stern immersion across loading/trim states; preserve righting and seakeeping checks.

hydrodynamics.hull_interference_method: Parameter sweep of centreline spacing and demihull shape against a matched isolated-demihull baseline; quantify interference over speed and loading rather than optimise one point.
hydrodynamics.resistance_method: Start with transparent low-fidelity estimates only for screening; validate CFD/model-test method before ranking quantitative resistance. Keep appendage, aerodynamic and fouling assumptions visible.
hydrodynamics.propulsor_configuration: Compare appropriately sized retractable or fixed twin auxiliary propulsors; measure drag, manoeuvring and redundancy effects. Sailing remains primary energy source.
hydrodynamics.foil_configuration: No hydrofoils in baseline; optional daggerboard/keel variants are explicitly sailing appendages, not assumed lift foils.
reference_cases: Delft 372 catamaran research as a validation-method anchor only; geometry and regime differ from this sailing yacht.
ITTC resistance/propulsion validation procedure; exact compatible cases and rights require review.
hydrodynamics.uncertainty_method: Keep model-form, input/sea-state, measurement, numerical and applicability uncertainty separate; no physical prediction until calibrated against suitable data.

seakeeping.wave_climate_basis: Define the actual target-route wave scatter diagram and encounter-angle/period distributions before establishing an operating envelope.
seakeeping.wet_deck_impact_method: Compare time-domain wave/bridge-deck clearance screening followed by model-test or validated CFD for candidate designs; use worst operating load and uncertainty.
seakeeping.ride_comfort_method: Use response statistics, acceleration exposure and seasickness/comfort proxies at declared speeds and headings; validate interpretation with naval-architecture expertise.

structure_and_safety.cross_deck_load_path: No scantlings set. Analyse global torsion, cross-deck bending, local wet-deck impacts, rig loads and cyclic fatigue for sailing load cases.
structure_and_safety.fatigue_method: Define wave-cycle and rig-load spectra, detail hot spots and lifecycle assumptions; class/structural validation required.
structure_and_safety.asymmetric_flooding_method: Assess damage/asymmetric flooding where applicable, reserve buoyancy, compartmentation, escape and stability for the applicable vessel category.
structure_and_safety.stability_method: Qualified intact/damage stability calculations across lightship, tanks, stores, crew/guest loads, sail/reefing states and flooding assumptions.
structure_and_safety.foil_failure_mode_method: Not applicable to baseline; sailing appendages and steering failures still need degraded-mode and collision/grounding assessments.
structure_and_safety.redundancy_and_degraded_modes: Safe reefed mode, mast/rig damage, rudder/board failure, loss of one auxiliary propulsor and emergency steering/communications.
structure_and_safety.approval_basis: Determine flag/registration, construction category, intended offshore operating limits and class/standard applicability with qualified professionals.

propulsion_candidates: sail-primary with efficient twin electric auxiliary propulsors
sail-primary with range-extender generation and battery buffer
all-electric auxiliary variant for harbour and low-noise manoeuvring
energy_carriers: lifecycle-reviewed liquid fuel for redundancy/range extension

battery_capacity_mwh.rationale: Size after hotel and manoeuvring loads, mass, reserve, thermal/fire separation and charging profile are defined.

energy_architecture.mode_resolved_load_basis: Build separate 15-minute load cases for sailing, calms, manoeuvring, anchor, cooking, refrigeration, water production, charging and emergency loads.
energy_architecture.shore_power_or_charging: Port shore-power availability and charging time are route-specific; do not assume universal supply.
energy_architecture.renewable_assist: Sail plan is primary propulsion; solar is evaluated against usable area, shade, route irradiance and maintenance. Do not claim fixed propulsion contribution.
energy_architecture.emissions_boundary: Report onboard fuel/energy separately from upstream well-to-wake emissions and battery manufacture/replacement assumptions.
energy_architecture.reserve_policy: Define sailing reserve, auxiliary fuel, battery state-of-charge reserve and safe divert policy after route/weather profile.

payload_and_operations.mission_payload: Cruising stores, freshwater, safety gear, tender and maintenance inventory are part of a mass/volume budget, not post-design additions.
payload_and_operations.port_or_mooring_envelope: Overall beam, draft, mast height, anchorage swing and marina constraints are first-class constraints.
payload_and_operations.maintainability: Design access to rigging, steering, drive trains, batteries and through-hulls for offshore service without compromising watertight integrity.
payload_and_operations.crew_workload: Evaluate reefing, tacking, line handling, anchoring and emergency procedures with realistic small-crew task analysis.
payload_and_operations.emergency_access: Preserve exits, fore/aft movement, tender access, recovery of person overboard and machinery isolation.

availability_target.rationale: Provisional availability goal for an expedition/cruising mission; assumptions and maintenance data needed.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Compare equivalent route/weather, guest-service loads, stores and safety reserves.
performance_targets.validation_method: Validated route energy model and measured auxiliary loads; publish wind/sea-state strata.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Route-aware sailing baseline with the same rig, payload and weather window.
performance_targets.validation_method: Sea trials over a prespecified wind/wave envelope, with excluded conditions explicit.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Defined stability, slamming, rig-load, flooding and route-access fault controls.
performance_targets.validation_method: Adversarial evaluator with hidden truth and qualified thresholds; zero unsafe false-feasible outcomes.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Matched wave climate, encounter heading/speed, loading and clearance geometry.
performance_targets.validation_method: Model tests or validated time-domain analysis with uncertainty and event definition.

hard_constraints.description: Intact and applicable damage/asymmetric flooding stability over declared loading, rig and tank states.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Qualified naval-architecture calculations and the applicable flag/standard review.

hard_constraints.description: Global cross-deck bending/torsion, rig foundations, cyclic wave loads and local wet-deck impact strength.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Structural/fatigue analysis with suitable load spectra and review.

hard_constraints.description: Wet-deck impact, green-water and slamming exposure within the declared operation envelope.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Validated model-test or numerical evidence; unsupported conditions stay out of envelope.

hard_constraints.description: Emergency steering, appendage damage, flooding and propulsion-degraded conditions.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Failure-mode analysis and demonstrated safe operational procedures.

hard_constraints.description: Draft, beam, mast height, mooring, shelter/refuge and route-weather limits.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Verified route/port constraints and qualified operating manual.

hard_constraints.description: Battery/fuel fire, ventilation, isolation and escape arrangements.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Energy-system hazard analysis and applicable standards review.

assumptions.statement: One hull-spacing ratio will remain efficient over a broad speed and wave envelope.
assumptions.falsification_method: Compare multiple spacing candidates over Froude number, loading and waves; preserve off-design cases.

assumptions.statement: A slenderer demihull can reduce wave-making/resistance without eroding payload and damage tolerance beyond acceptable limits.
assumptions.falsification_method: Compare displacement, wetted area, trim, volume distribution, structure and stability for matched payload.

assumptions.statement: A high bridge-deck clearance can reduce impact exposure without excessive mass/CG/structure penalty.
assumptions.falsification_method: Use wave scatter diagram, dynamic response, bridge-deck pressure and mass/vertical-CG trade studies.

provenance.title: CFD validation for Delft 372 Catamaran in static drift conditions
provenance.scope: Reference methodology for calm-water drift, loads, sinkage/trim, PIV and wave-pattern validation; geometry/conditions must match before quantitative use.

provenance.title: Experimental catamaran head-wave benchmark with uncertainty quantification
provenance.scope: Regular and irregular head-wave responses and statistical uncertainty analysis; source record notes access restrictions, so do not redistribute source data without permission.

provenance.title: ITTC CFD validation benchmark database for resistance and propulsion
provenance.scope: Procedure describing selection and use of resistance/propulsion CFD validation cases; not blanket permission to redistribute linked data.

provenance.title: IMO High-speed craft safety framework
provenance.scope: Applicability and overview of HSC Code for qualifying high-speed craft; route and vessel-specific applicability review required.

provenance.title: IMO ship design and stability
provenance.scope: Public overview of SOLAS ship design, subdivision and stability requirements; not a complete compliance checklist.

provenance.title: Condor/Artemis EF-24 electric ferry project report
provenance.scope: Project-reported 24 m hydrofoil ferry concept with up to 150 passengers, 100 nmi and 38 kn; comparison anchor only, not independent validation.

claim_ceiling: Concept hypothesis only; not a seaworthy design, performance guarantee, offshore operating limit or class approval.
